SPECIFY_DATA: Specify your extracted game data location
BUILD_WARNING_BODY:
The APK signing certificate or packaged native libraries could not be verified.

GWSC and Online are unavailable.
Install the official build from the project's official channel.
DATA_UNAVAILABLE: Game data is unavailable or incomplete. Select a game data location.
DATA_MISSING_ITEMS: This folder is missing required files or folders:
DATA_PATH_TOO_LONG: This folder path is too long. Move the game to a folder closer to the storage root.
ALL_FILES_NEEDED: Allow access to all files in Android settings, then select your game data location again.
DATA_PATH_HINT: Enter the full path to the extracted game folder.
STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This folder cannot be read. Check storage access and whether the drive is mounted.
LAUNCHER_ONLY: This test build does not include the game engine.
OCCLUSION_WARNING_BODY: Your selected graphics driver cannot report precise visibility counts. Some mission photos may not recognize visible targets, including the security cameras and keypad in Casing the Jewel Store and the guards in Scouting the Port. These objectives may be impossible to complete. You can try another compatible graphics driver.
MISSING_PACK_BODY:
A required game file is missing or damaged:

%s

Reinstall or verify the game data from the launcher.
VULKAN_OLD_DRIVER:
Your device’s graphics driver is too old (Vulkan %s; this game requires Vulkan 1.3 or newer).

If you have a compatible Vulkan 1.3 or newer driver, import it.
RESULT_FRAMES: %1$s of frames at 60 fps or better, %2$s at 30 fps or better; 99%% under %3$d ms
DESC_RESOLUTION: The resolution the game renders at. Lower is faster; Native is the screen's own.
DESC_VSYNC: Waits for the screen's refresh before showing a frame. Off can feel faster but may tear.
DESC_FPS: The frame rate the game holds to. Lower targets save battery and heat.
DESC_PINNING: Places the game's threads on the fast and slow CPU cores itself. Off leaves it to Android; try On if your phone stutters.
DESC_DRIVER: The Vulkan driver used by the game. If you have a compatible Vulkan 1.3 or newer driver, import it.
DESC_IMPORT: Import a compatible Vulkan 1.3 or newer driver pack (.zip with meta.json).
DESC_PRESET: Low, Default or Ultra graphics, or Custom to set each one yourself.
DESC_RUN: Runs the game's benchmark (about 4 minutes) and shows the results when it ends.
DESC_REMOVE_DRIVER: Deletes an imported driver from the game. If it was in use, the game goes back to the phone's own driver.
SETTINGS_NOTE: Applied the next time the game starts.
WORKAROUNDS: Skip cloud files, transactions and catalog
SERVER_MESSAGE: Empty uses %1$s (%2$s), compiled in from rline/gwsc.cpp.
BAD_HOST: A host name or address, without https:// or a path.
NICKNAME_MESSAGE: Other players see it; the game uses it from the next sign-in.
PASSWORD_MESSAGE: Every other device is signed out.
SIGN_OUT_ALL_MESSAGE: Ends every session of this account: the website, other devices and this launcher.
NO_FRIENDS: No friends yet. Add someone by nickname above.
NO_SERVER: No server: set one under Server.
QUOTES: The email and password cannot contain double quotes.
BENCHMARK_MESSAGE: Runs the built-in benchmark (all five passes, with frame times). The game quits when it finishes; results are written to %s.
COMMAND_LINE_MESSAGE: Extra engine arguments, added on every launch. Separate with spaces or lines; "double quotes" keep spaces; # comments out a line.
CLEAR_MESSAGE: Deletes the translated shaders and the pipeline cache (%.1f MB). The next launch rebuilds them and stutters while it does.
CACHE_PARTIAL: Some cache files could not be deleted
STORE_FREE: Free on %s. Claimed cards reach your bank when you're back in a session.
STORE_SIGN_IN: Sign in on the launcher's GTA Online tab first.
NOT_GWSC: The server at %s did not answer like a GWSC server.
GUIDANCE: Drag a control to move it. Select one to adjust its size.
UPDATE_APP: A new version of the game is ready to download.
UPDATE_FILES: New game files are ready to download.
FILES_MISSING: The game files are not downloaded yet.
JOIN_SIGNIN: Sign in to GWSC to join sessions.
JOIN_NOSESSION: %1$s is not in a joinable session.
SELECT_FRIEND: Select a friend to see their profile.
FRIENDS_ONLY: Only friends can see achievements and stats.
NO_CONVERSATIONS: No conversations yet. Message a friend from their profile, or start a group with +.
BLOCK_CONFIRM: Block %1$s? You'll stop being friends, and they can't send you requests or messages.
PICTURE_WEB: Upload your own picture on the website.
INVITE_FAILED: Could not invite %1$s: you need to be in a GTA Online session.
KEEP_OFFLINE: Unable to connect to %1$s. Keep offline mode?
DEBUG_SCRIPT_MODE: Debug scripts: game files are not verified.
VERIFY_FILES: Game files need checking or repair. Choose Download to check them, or Import.
NEEDS_REPAIR: Game files need repair. Tap Download.
PREPARED_WAIT: Game files prepared. Now sit back, relax and wait for the 12th.
MIRROR_HINT: Each mirror was tested from this device: the ping, then the download speed. The fastest is selected; pick another if it suits your connection better.
MIRROR_HINT_LAST: Each mirror was tested from this device: the ping, then the download speed. Your last mirror is selected; pick another to switch.
NO_MIRROR: No mirror answered with the game files. Check your connection and test again.
PRELOAD_VERIFIED: Preload already verified. Checking for the game update…
CRASH_SAVED: The game closed unexpectedly. A crash log was saved to Downloads as %s. Share it with the developers so they can fix it.
CRASH_LOW_MEMORY: Android closed the game because the device ran out of memory. Close other apps, or lower the resolution and graphics settings. A log was saved to Downloads as %s.
CRASH_NOT_SAVED: The game closed unexpectedly. Its log is in the game's userdata folder as GameCrash.log.
IMPORT_DONE: Game files in place: %1$d. Still to download: %2$d.
DESC_TEXTURES: Very High streams the game's HD textures; High leaves them out; Normal also halves each large texture. Default is Normal on phones with less than about 9.5 GB of RAM, where Very High runs out of memory, and Very High on the rest.
UP_TO_DATE: Game files are up to date.
ALLOW_INSTALLS: Allow installs from Fuzzy, then tap Check for updates again.
CONFIRM_INSTALL: Confirm the update in Android's installer.
